answer_2.quote: Task Accuracy The accuracies shown in Tables ... are computed by allowing models to generate conclusions and considering an answer successful when it contains at least one of the correct conclusions.

answer_3.quote: we used LLaMA-3-inst 8B to annotate the generated conclusions. To verify the reliability of the model we manually annotated 441 conclusions with LLaMA-3-inst 8B obtaining 93.42% accuracy w.r.t human judgment.
